extract: Shree Renuka Sugars Ltd. is India's largest sugar refiner and ethanol producer based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with refining capacity of 4000 tonnes/day and distillery capacity of 600 kilolitre/day. It accounted for 20% of India's international sugar contribution in 2019.
